newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends firm, in line with domestic cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends firm, in line with domestic cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher in quiet dealings with the futures market about in line with the U.S. domestic cash market, traders said.
"The market is tracking cash right on the money," a trader said.
Rice futures continued to edge higher on a continuation of the outside breakout Friday, he said, but he noted "a fair amount of hedge selling over the market."
Rice futures volume was estimated at 450 contracts, up from 332 Monday. Rice options volume was estimated at 40 lots, up from 19 Monday.
Rice futures closed three to six cents per cwt higher, with November up three at $9.99 per cwt.
